description: This file implements the 'git reset' command, a core part of the Git version control system. It handles various reset operations such as moving HEAD, updating the index, and optionally modifying the working directory, supporting multiple reset modes like soft, mixed, hard, merge, and keep. The file includes functions for parsing command-line arguments, updating refs, manipulating the index and working tree, and printing status messages.

methods.name: int reset_index(const char * ref,const struct object_id * oid,int reset_type,int quiet)
methods.description: Resets the index to match a specified tree or commit, updating index entries based on the reset type (mixed, soft, hard, merge, keep). Handles unpacking trees and updating cache entries.

methods.name: void print_new_head_line(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Prints a message indicating the new HEAD position after a reset, including an abbreviated commit hash and an oneline description.

methods.name: void update_index_from_diff(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * opt UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Updates the index entries based on differences between the current index and a specified tree, optionally marking entries for intent-to-add.

methods.name: int read_from_tree(const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct object_id * tree_oid,int intent_to_add)
methods.description: Reads a specified tree into the index, optionally intent-to-adding files based on a diff between trees.

methods.name: void set_reflog_message(struct strbuf * sb,const char * action,const char * rev)
methods.description: Constructs a message for reflog entries detailing the reset action.

methods.name: void die_if_unmerged_cache(int reset_type)
methods.description: Terminates if the index is in a merge state or contains unmerged entries, preventing resets during a merge.

methods.name: void parse_args(struct pathspec * pathspec,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,int patch_mode,const char ** rev_ret)
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine the target revision, paths, and reset options.

methods.name: int reset_refs(const char * rev,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Updates refs such as HEAD and ORIG_HEAD to reflect the reset position.

methods.name: int git_reset_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Handles configuration options specific to the reset command.

methods.name: int cmd_reset(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
